proposition: About 829/1426 Qāżīzāda Rūmī wrote from Samarkand thanking Ibn Turka for a copy of his Sharḥ al-Basmala, saying he had met him in Herat and reminding him of a promise to visit Samarkand.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to received from Qāżīzāda Rūmī
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK dates it by the treatise's completion 'by 829/1426'
